name: Ghost
tagline: Open source publishing platform. The professional alternative to Substack and Medium.
shortDescription: Ghost powers some of the world's largest publications (The Verge, Trello, Duolingo, etc.). It's a Node.js CMS purpose-built for newsletters, memberships, and paid content. MIT-licensed and self-hostable.
longDescription:
## What it is

Ghost is a modern publishing platform built for professional creators and publishers. It handles the entire workflow: writing in a beautiful editor, distributing via newsletter (with built-in email delivery), and monetizing via memberships and paid subscriptions.

## Why we recommend it

It is the only open source platform that does the entire newsletter-to-paid-pipeline out of the box. No need to glue together ConvertKit + Memberful + Substack — Ghost handles all three. Self-hosting is trivial (one `ghost` npm package, one CLI command), and the managed Ghost(Pro) option starts at $9/mo with no per-newsletter-subscriber fees.

## When to use it

- Newsletters with 1k+ subscribers (where Substack/ConvertKit start charging meaningfully)
- Paid membership sites
- Indie publications and journalism
- Personal blogs that need to look professional without WordPress
installCommand: npm install ghost-cli -g && ghost install local
installInstructions:
**Self-host:**
1. Requires Node 18+, MySQL 8, and a reverse proxy (nginx or Caddy)
2. `npm install -g ghost-cli`
3. `mkdir my-site && cd my-site`
4. `ghost install local` (uses sqlite for local dev)
5. `ghost install` (production, uses MySQL)
6. The admin is at `yourdomain.com/ghost/`

**Managed (easier):** Sign up at https://ghost.org, connect your domain, start writing. $9/mo Starter, $25/mo Creator, $199/mo Team.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free, you pay hosting. Ghost(Pro): $9/mo starter (up to 100 members), $25/mo creator (1,000 members), $199/mo team (10,000 members).
